reopened_reason: The exact unordered per-column capacity profile sharply reduces but does not eliminate ZOE aggregation collisions on 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4, so the remaining distinction can depend on which capacity state belongs to which REL_INC column role.

new_assertions.body: Capacity distribution and capacity-to-incidence alignment are distinct structural coordinates: an unordered capacity multiset can be exact while still forgetting which residual role carries which support height.
The remaining 4x4/4x5 failures justify jointly canonicalizing column capacity labels with REL_INC rather than adding unrelated component features.

Role alignment should itself be graded minimally: test aligned capacity parity, then aligned zero/positive-odd/positive-even labels, with exact aligned capacity retained only as a reconstruction control.

If exact role-aligned capacity plus REL_INC does not reproduce exact-type ZOE scalar purity, the descriptor construction is mechanically incomplete; if it does, any coarser passing role label is a genuine structural compression candidate.
